blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis enables computational diagnosis and prognosis, but gigapixel images and limited annotations make slide-level learning challenging. Multiple instance learning addresses this task by aggregating patch representations from frozen pretrained encoders. Recently, Mamba has enabled efficient modeling of long patch sequences. However, task supervision alone does not explicitly constrain information recovery during feature adaptation, while Mamba couples local processing with long-range propagation rather than retaining separate representations for fusion. Motivated by these challenges, we introduce LEAF-Mamba, a framework that jointly addresses latent evidence adaptation and fusion for frozen-feature WSI analysis. A reconstruction-regularized adapter learns compact, task-specific representations while reconstructing the input features. Parallel Mamba and convolutional streams then capture long-range dependencies and sequence-local interactions, with an input-dependent gate modulating their joint representation before slide-level pooling. Experiments across feature extractors demonstrate improved average performance over strong MIL baselines in both diagnostic classification and survival prediction. Component analyses further support the contributions of adaptation and fusion. These findings highlight the value of jointly designing feature transformation and contextual aggregation to translate pretrained representations into effective slide-level predictions.
blocks.zh: 整个幻灯片图像(WSI)分析可以进行计算诊断和预测,但千兆像素图像和有限的说明使得幻灯片级别的学习具有挑战性. 多个实例学习通过汇总被冻结的被预先训练的编码器的补丁表达来应对这项任务. 最近,曼巴实现了长补丁序列的高效建模. 然而,单靠任务监督并不能明确限制适应特征过程中的信息恢复,而曼巴夫妇则通过远距离传播在当地进行处理,而不是保留单独的聚变表述。 在这些挑战的推动下,我们引入了LEAF-Mamba,这个框架将共同处理潜在的证据适应和聚变,以便进行WSI冷冻特性分析。 重建规范化的适配器在重建输入特征的同时会学习紧凑,任务特有的表现. 然后平行的曼巴和相生流捕捉到长距离的依赖性和序列-局部的相互作用,一个以输入为依存的门在滑行级集合之前会调节他们的联合代表. 跨地物提取器的实验表明,在诊断分类和生存预测两方面,平均性能均高于强的MIL基线。 构成部分分析进一步支持适应和融合的贡献。 这些结论突出了联合设计地物转换和上下文汇总的价值,以便将事先训练过的表示转化为有效的幻灯片级预测.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Whole slide images (WSIs) capture the cellular morphology and tissue organization used for computational cancer diagnosis and prognosis [ 1 ] .
Predicting a diagnostic category or patient outcome from a gigapixel slide requires aggregating evidence across heterogeneous tissue.
Dense region-level annotation demands extensive pathologist effort, so weakly supervised WSI models learn from slide- or patient-level labels [ 2 ] .
Multiple instance learning (MIL) represents each slide as a bag of patches and learns a bag-level predictor.
Attention-based pooling weights patch contributions, while clustering-constrained learning adds a clustering objective to slide-level training [ 3 , 4 ] .
Dual-stream methods identify critical instances, while feature-distillation methods learn slide representations through pseudo-bag training [ 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
整个幻灯片图像(WSI)捕捉用于计算癌症诊断和预测的细胞形态和组织组织[1].
通过千兆像素滑动预测诊断类别或病人结果,需要将各种组织的证据汇总起来。
敏锐的区域级注释需要广泛的病理学家努力,因此监督不力的WSI模型从幻灯片或病人级标签中学习[2].
多例学习(MIL)代表每个幻灯片作为包补丁,并学习包级预测器.
基于注意力的集合权重补丁贡献,而集群约束的学习则为幻灯片级培训增加了一个集群目标[3,4].
双流方法确定关键实例,而特性稀释方法通过假包培训学习幻灯片表达[5、6]。

blocks.en:
In frozen-feature MIL, a pretrained encoder extracts patch embeddings, and a trainable aggregator maps them to slide-level predictions.
Pathology foundation models learn reusable patch representations from large tissue-image collections [ 7 , 8 ] .
Transformer-based MIL models contextual interactions among patches [ 9 ] , while selective state-space models process long sequences with computational cost that scales linearly with sequence length [ 10 ] .
MambaMIL applies this sequence modeling to WSIs through patch reordering [ 11 ] .
SemaMIL further studies semantic ordering and retrieval-guided state-space aggregation [ 12 ] , highlighting the role of sequence construction alongside the choice of sequence operator.
We focus on two stages of this pipeline: adapting frozen embeddings to the target task and combining short- and long-range contextual representations.
blocks.zh:
在冷冻版的MIL中,一个预先训练的编码器提取补丁嵌入,以及一个可训练的聚合器将它们映射到滑动级的预测.
病理基础模型从大型组织图集中学习可重复使用的补丁表达[7,8].
基于变形器的MIL模型在补丁之间的上下文相互作用[9],而选择性的状态-空间模型处理长序,其计算成本与序列长度成线性比例[10].
MambaMIL通过补丁重排将这个序列模型应用于WSIs [11].
SemaMIL进一步研究语义定序和检索制导的状态-空间聚合[12],强调序列构造与序列操作员选择的作用.
我们侧重于这一管道的两个阶段:根据目标任务调整冷冻嵌入物,以及结合短期和长期背景表述。

blocks.en:
The first challenge is to adapt frozen features from bag-level supervision.
The frozen encoder receives no updates from the downstream diagnostic or survival loss, leaving feature adaptation to the slide-level model.
Re-embedding methods such as RRTMIL learn transformations before aggregation [ 13 ] .
The task loss supervises the transformed patches through the slide prediction, but does not explicitly constrain recovery of their input features.
A reconstruction loss supplies this missing constraint by penalizing input-recovery error for each compressed patch representation.
Joint optimization therefore gives the adapter two objectives: predict the slide-level outcome and reconstruct the frozen patch embeddings.
blocks.zh:
第一个挑战是从袋层监管中调整冷冻特征.
冷冻编码器没有收到下游诊断或生存损失的更新,留下特征适应滑动级模型.
RRTMIL等重置方法在聚合[13]前学习变换.
任务损失通过幻灯片预测来监督转换后的补丁,但没有明确限制其输入特性的恢复.
重建损失通过惩罚每个压缩补丁的输入恢复错误,提供了这一缺失的制约因素。
因此,联合优化给适配器带来了两个目标:预测幻灯片级结果和重建冷冻补丁嵌入.

blocks.en:
The second challenge is to retain distinct short- and long-range representations for fusion.
In a standard Mamba block, local convolution feeds the selective state-space operation, placing short-range processing on the same path as long-range propagation [ 10 ] .
The convolutional output is not retained as a separate representation for fusion with the Mamba output.
A parallel convolutional stream preserves the sequence-local representation alongside the long-range output.
An input-dependent gate modulates their joint features before pooling.
Figure 1 illustrates the parallel streams and their input-dependent fusion.
blocks.zh:
第二个挑战是为核聚变保留独特的短期和长期表述。
在一个标准的Mamba块中,局部演化为选择性的状态-空间操作提供素材,将短程处理置于与远程传播相同的路径上[10].
转动输出不保留作为与曼巴输出融合的单独代表.
平行的演化流保留了序列-局部代表与长程输出.
一个依赖输入的门在集合前会调节它们的联合特性.
图1显示平行流及其依赖输入的聚变。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Conceptual visualization of Mamba-guided evidence fusion.
blocks.zh: 图1:曼巴制导证据聚变的概念可视化。

blocks.en:
We propose LEAF-Mamba, a frozen-feature MIL framework that combines reconstruction-regularized latent evidence adaptation (LEA) with Mamba-guided evidence fusion (EF). LEA maps each patch embedding to a compact code through a nonlinear encoder and a linear skip projection.
The task loss and an auxiliary reconstruction loss jointly train the adapter, and the reconstruction decoder is removed at inference. EF processes the adapted tokens through parallel Mamba and convolutional streams along a fixed coordinate-derived ordering.
The convolutional stream models consecutive tokens in this sequence.
The two outputs are concatenated and projected, then modulated by a content-dependent sigmoid gate before slide-level pooling.
blocks.zh:
我们提议LEAF-Mamba,这是一个冷冻的MIL框架,将重建 -- -- 正规化的潜在证据适应(LEA)与Mamba制导的证据聚变(EF)结合起来。 LEA通过非线性编码器和线性跳过投影将每个补丁嵌入到一个紧凑的编码中.
任务损失和辅助重建损失联合训练适配器,重建解码器在推断时被移除. EF通过平行的Mamba和沿固定坐标生成命令的演化流处理经过调整的符号。
演化流模型在这个序列中连续表示符号.
两种产出均进行调和和预测,然后在幻灯片级集合之前由一个内容依赖的sigmoid门进行调制.

blocks.en:
We evaluate LEAF-Mamba on diagnostic classification and survival prediction using frozen ResNet-50, PLIP, and CONCH v1.5 features.
All reproduced baselines share the extracted features, data splits, and evaluation protocol. LEAF-Mamba achieves the highest mean diagnostic AUC and mean survival C-Index among the compared methods with each encoder.
On the BRACS official split with CONCH v1.5 features, removing reconstruction reduces AUC from 76.8 to 75.8 under global-only aggregation.
With both branches enabled, input-dependent fusion improves AUC by 0.8 percentage points over a learned static gate.
Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh:
我们利用冷冻ResNet-50、PLIP和CONCH v1.5等特性,对LEAF-Mamba进行诊断分类和生存预测。
所有转载的基线都共享提取特征、数据分割和评价协议。 LEAF-Mamba实现最高平均诊断AUC,在与每个编码器的比较方法中平均存活C-Index.
关于BRCS官方与CONCH v1.5特性的分裂,删除重建后,AUC在全局汇总下从76.8减少到75.8.
在两个分支都启用后,依赖输入的聚变比学习到的静态门提高0.8个百分点.
我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. We introduce a reconstruction-regularized latent adapter for frozen-feature MIL. Joint bag-level prediction and patchwise reconstruction train compact task-specific codes; the decoder is removed at inference. 2. We develop an evidence-fusion module that retains parallel Mamba and sequence-local convolutional representations and modulates their projected joint features through an input-dependent gate before pooling. 3. We show that LEAF-Mamba achieves the highest mean diagnostic AUC and survival C-Index among the compared methods with each of three frozen encoders. Controlled ablations quantify the contributions of reconstruction and context fusion.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们推出一个重建规范的潜在适配器 用于冷冻的MIL。 联合包级预测和补丁重建列车紧凑任务专用代码;解码器在推论时被移除. 2. 我们开发了一个证据组合模块,保留平行的Mamba和顺序-局部演化表述,并通过一个依赖输入的门调节其预测的联合特征,然后集合。 3. 我们显示,LEAF-Mamba在与三个冷冻编码器进行对比的方法中实现了最高平均诊断AUC和存活C-Index。 控制下的烧伤量化了重建和环境融合的贡献。

blocks.en: We introduce a reconstruction-regularized latent adapter for frozen-feature MIL. Joint bag-level prediction and patchwise reconstruction train compact task-specific codes; the decoder is removed at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们推出一个重建规范的潜在适配器 用于冷冻的MIL。 联合包级预测和补丁重建列车紧凑任务专用代码;解码器在推论时被移除.

blocks.en: We develop an evidence-fusion module that retains parallel Mamba and sequence-local convolutional representations and modulates their projected joint features through an input-dependent gate before pooling.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个证据组合模块,保留平行的Mamba和顺序-局部演化代表,并通过一个依赖输入的门来调节其预测的联合特征,然后集合。

blocks.en: We show that LEAF-Mamba achieves the highest mean diagnostic AUC and survival C-Index among the compared methods with each of three frozen encoders. Controlled ablations quantify the contributions of reconstruction and context fusion.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,LEAF-Mamba在与三个冷冻编码器的每一种方法进行比较中,实现了最高的AUC平均诊断和存活C-Index。 控制下的烧伤量化了重建和环境融合的贡献。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Related work for LEAF-Mamba spans slide-level aggregation, long-sequence modeling, and frozen-feature adaptation.
blocks.zh: LEAF-Mamba公司的相关工作涉及幻灯片级聚合、长序建模和冷冻版改造。

blocks.en: 2.1 MIL for whole slide image analysis
blocks.zh: 2.1 用于全幻灯片图像分析的MIL

blocks.en:
In weakly supervised WSI analysis, MIL represents a slide as a bag of patch features and learns from slide-level labels without dense annotation, despite large bag sizes and patch heterogeneity.
Attention-based MIL learns a slide summary from instance weights, and CLAM adds clustering constraints to make attention pooling more data-efficient in pathology [ 3 , 4 ] .
DSMIL uses a dual stream to identify critical instances, while DTFD-MIL distills large bags through pseudo-bag training [ 5 , 6 ] .
Recent extensions shift the aggregation assumption in different directions: CAMIL adds neighborhood context, and ACMIL perturbs attention concentration through multi-branch masking [ 14 , 15 ] .
RPMIL models bag predictions probabilistically, whereas Jigsaw learns order restoration from spatial correlations [ 16 , 17 ] .
DomSet-MIL addresses a different aspect of weak supervision: a dominant slide label can conceal coexisting lesions, motivating censored-label modeling and residual routing of lesion evidence [ 18 ] .
RRTMIL is the closest feature re-embedding comparator because it adapts pathology features for foundation-model transfer [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
在弱监督的WSI分析中,MIL代表一个幻灯片,作为包包的补丁特性,在不密集注释的情况下从幻灯片级标签中学习,尽管包大小大,补丁异质.
基于关注的MIL从实例权重中学习幻灯片摘要,CLAM增加了集群限制,使注意力集聚在病理中更高效的数据[3,4].
DSMIL使用双流识别临界实例,而DTFD-MIL通过伪袋训练蒸馏大袋[5,6].
最近的扩展将集合假设向不同方向转移:CAMIL增加了邻里上下文,ACMIL通过多分支遮掩来扰动注意力集中[14,15].
RPMIL模型包的预测很可能会发生,而Jigsaw则从空间相关性中学习命令恢复[16,17].
DomSet-MIL处理监督薄弱的另一方面:一个主要的幻灯片标签可以掩盖各种损害并存,激发审查标签模型的建立和损害证据的剩余路径[18]。
RRTMIL是最接近的特性重置比较器,因为它适应了病理学特性,用于基础模型转移[13].

blocks.en: 2.2 Long-sequence modeling in pathology
blocks.zh: 2.2 病理学中的长序模型

blocks.en:
Transformer and interventional MIL extend independent pooling through contextual dependency and confounder-aware bag learning [ 9 , 19 ] .
Graph-based models encode relational or spatial context through tissue graphs [ 20 , 21 ] .
Hierarchical models aggregate local-to-slide representations across scales [ 22 , 23 ] .
Attention-based models can be computationally expensive for large bags, whereas graph and hierarchical models depend on relation construction or multi-scale design choices.
Structured state space and Mamba models offer a linear-time long-sequence alternative, with Mamba and VMamba establishing selective/state-space operators [ 10 , 24 ] .
S4MIL and MambaMIL adapt this direction to WSI sequences [ 25 , 11 ] .
SemaMIL combines semantic reordering with retrieval-guided state-space modeling [ 12 ] ; its sequence-construction strategy complements the study of parallel contextual streams.
MambaMIL is the closest sequence-side comparator to LEAF-Mamba [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
变形器和干预性MIL通过背景依赖和意识错乱的包学习扩展独立集合[9,19].
基于图表的模型通过组织图编码关系或空间上下文[20,21].
分级模型汇总了不同尺度的局部到滑坡的表示[22,23].
基于注意力的模型对于大袋来说可能计算成本昂贵,而图和等级模型则依赖于关系构造或多尺度的设计选择.
结构化状态空间和曼巴模型提供了一个线性长序替代方案,由曼巴和V曼巴建立选择性/状态空间运营商[10,24].
S4MIL和MambaMIL使这个方向适应WSI序列[25,11].
SemaMIL将语义重排与检索制导的状态-空间模型[12]相结合;其序列构建策略补充了平行背景流的研究.
MambaMIL是LEAF-Mamba[11]最接近的序列边参照物.

blocks.en: 2.3 Pathology foundation models and representation mismatch
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 病理基础模型和表现不匹配

blocks.en:
Pathology foundation models improve frozen patch representations: CTransPath uses pathology-specific contrastive pretraining, and PLIP adds vision-language supervision [ 26 , 27 ] .
Broader general-purpose and clinical-grade encoders expand transfer across pathology tasks [ 7 , 8 ] .
Recent multimodal whole-slide encoders extend this trend with image-text supervision [ 28 , 29 ] .
FG-PAN refines visual patches and aligns them with fine-grained descriptions for zero-shot brain tumor subtyping [ 30 ] . MeDKCoOp uses graph-structured visual and textual knowledge for biomedical prompt adaptation [ 31 ] . Both study how reusable vision-language representations can be matched to domain-specific evidence.
Frozen representations can still benefit from downstream task adaptation, as investigated by RRTMIL [ 13 ] . The feature mismatch addressed by this adaptation is distinct from generalization to a new acquisition domain.
The comparison of interest is how the adaptation objective and aggregation operators contribute under the same frozen-feature protocol.
blocks.zh:
病理基础模型改善冷冻补丁表达:CTransPath使用病理特有的对比性预训,PLIP增加视觉语言监督[26,27].
更广泛的通用和临床级编码器扩展了跨病理学任务的转移[7,8].
最近的多式联运全滑编码器通过图像文本监督[28、29]扩展了这一趋势。
FG-PAN对视觉补丁进行了精细的改进,并将其与零射脑瘤亚型的精细描述一致[30]. MeDKCoOp使用图结构的视觉和文字知识进行生物医学的即时适应[31]. 这两项研究都研究了可重复使用的视觉语言表达方式如何与特定领域的证据相匹配.
如RRTMIL[13]所调查,冻结的表述仍可从下游任务调整中受益。 这一调整所处理的特征不匹配问题不同于泛化到一个新的获取领域。
利息的比较是适应目标和汇总操作员如何根据相同的冻结地层协议作出贡献。

blocks.en: 2.4 Adapters and hybrid sequence operators
blocks.zh: 2.4 适应器和混合序列操作器

blocks.en: Bottleneck and residual adaptation have established precedents. Houlsby et al. insert trainable adapters within a frozen language model [ 32 ] , whereas CLIP-Adapter applies bottleneck transformations and residual blending to pretrained features [ 33 ] . These architectures motivate simple adapter controls; their supervision and insertion points differ from adaptation of offline WSI features. RRTMIL is the closer protocol-level reference because it re-embeds extracted patch features before MIL aggregation [ 13 ] . For aggregation, Conformer combines convolutional receptive fields with long-range attention in speech recognition [ 34 ] . This supports a general design precedent for combining local and global operators, while the value of a chosen serialization in WSI analysis remains an empirical question.
blocks.zh: Bottleneck和剩余适应已经建立了先例。 胡尔斯比等. 将可训练的适配器插入冷冻语言模型[32],而CLIP-Adapter则将瓶颈转换和剩余混合用于预训练特征[33]。 这些架构激发了简单的适配器控制;其监督和插入点不同于离线WSI特性的适应. RRTMIL是比较接近的协议级参考,因为它在MIL聚合[13]前重新嵌入提取的补丁特性. 为汇总,Conformer结合了演绎式的可接受领域和语音识别中的远程关注[34]. 这支持将本地和全球运营商合并的一般设计先例,而WSI分析中选定的序列化的价值仍然是一个经验问题。

blocks.en: Spatial and semantic constraints also arise in other medical imaging settings. SSCM combines spatial alignment and semantic consistency for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution [ 35 ] . Its cross-contrast reconstruction setting differs from recovering frozen patch features, but provides a related example of coordinating local detail with semantic representations. In vision-language modeling, geometry-aware dense-to-expert reconstruction studies the conversion of pretrained models into specialized expert modules [ 36 ] . Here, adaptation instead operates on offline patch embeddings before contextual aggregation.
blocks.zh: 空间和语义限制也出现在其他医学成像环境中。 SSCM将空间对齐和语义一致性结合起来,用于多相位磁共振超分辨率[35]. 它的跨连续重建设置与恢复冷冻的补丁特征不同,但提供了一个相关的实例,将本地细节与语义表达相协调. 在视觉语言建模中,几何感知的密集到专家的重建研究将预先训练的模型转换成专业专家模块[36]. 在这里,适应在上下文聚合之前先在离线补丁嵌入上操作。

blocks.en: 2.5 Structural information and distributed aggregation
blocks.zh: 2.5 结构信息和分布式汇总

blocks.en: Preserving discriminative evidence during representation transformation is also studied in graph learning. GraphRefiner calibrates generic-token dominance in graph-text alignment [ 37 ] ; G 2 rammar encodes structural roles and semantic relationships [ 38 ] . The H4G preprint studies how hyperbolic embedding geometry can retain fine-grained graph structure [ 39 ] . These formulations provide related perspectives on distinguishing useful local information from a broad contextual representation.
blocks.zh: 在表征转变过程中保留歧视性证据也在图征学习中研究. Graphiner 校准在图文本对齐中的通用调值主导 [37]; G 2 rammar 编码结构角色和语义关系 [38]. H4G预印研究了双曲嵌入几何结构如何能保留精细的纹理图结构[39]. 这些提法为区分有用的地方信息与广泛的背景代表性提供了相关的观点。

blocks.en: Multi-agent research examines a complementary question: how should distributed information sources communicate? HyperAgent uses hyperedges to represent collaboration groups [ 40 ] , while EvoHyper evolves a shared hypergraph of agents and memory [ 41 ] . D 3 MAS coordinates task decomposition, reasoning, and distributed memory [ 42 ] , and graph-decoupling methods study knowledge sharing among agents [ 43 ] . At a conceptual level, these works connect the organization of individual information sources with their collective use. In WSI analysis, the corresponding design problem concerns patch representations and their aggregation under slide-level supervision.
blocks.zh: 多代理研究研究了一个补充问题:如何传播信息来源? HyperAgent使用超对流来代表协作组[40],而EvoHyper则演化出一个共享的代理和内存的超对流图[41]. D 3 MAS 协调任务分解,推理,以及分布式内存[42],图解方法研究代理人之间的知识共享[43]. 在概念层面,这些工程将个别信息来源的组织与集体使用联系起来。 在WSI分析中,相应的设计问题涉及补丁表达及其在幻灯片层监督下的汇总.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
LEAF-Mamba transforms frozen patch embeddings, models them through long-range and sequence-local paths, and combines the resulting features before gated attention pooling. The adapter and aggregator are trained jointly with slide-level supervision, while the patch encoder remains frozen.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We organize the experiments around three questions.
First, does the representation-and-evidence design remain useful across feature extractors?
Second, does the same principle carry from diagnostic classification to noisier survival prediction?
Third, do controlled variants support the roles assigned to LEA, local modeling, and gated fusion?
We first define the datasets and unified protocol, then answer these questions through benchmark comparisons and targeted ablations.
blocks.zh:
我们围绕三个问题组织实验
第一,代表性和证据设计是否仍然在功能提取器中有用?
第二,同一原则是否从诊断性分类到噪声生存预测?
第三,控制变体是否支持分配给LEA的角色,局部建模,以及门式聚变?
我们首先确定数据集和统一协议,然后通过基准比较和有针对性的模拟来回答这些问题。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和协议

blocks.en: We evaluate LEAF-Mamba on both diagnostic classification and survival prediction under a unified frozen-feature protocol. For diagnostic classification, we use EBRAINS for 30-class brain tumor subtyping [ 44 ] , BRACS for 7-class breast lesion classification [ 45 ] , and Camelyon16 for breast cancer metastasis detection [ 46 ] . BRACS is evaluated with both 5-fold cross-validation and its official split. For survival prediction, we use five cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA): BLCA, BRCA, COADREAD, STAD, and HNSC [ 47 ] . Prognostic performance is measured by Concordance Index (C-Index) and reported as C-Index × 100 \times 100 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价LEAF-Mamba的诊断分类和根据统一的冷冻环境协议进行的生存预测。 对于诊断分类,我们使用EBRAINS进行30级脑瘤亚型[44],BRACS进行7级乳腺损伤分类[45],Camelyon16进行乳腺癌元病检测[46]. BRACS通过5倍的交叉验证和正式拆分来评价. 在生存预测方面,我们使用来自癌症基因组图集(TCGA)的五组:BLCA,BRCA,COADED,STAD,和HNSC[47]. 预测性能通过协和指数(C-Index)来衡量,并报告为C-Index × 100\times 100.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en:
All reproduced baselines reuse the same pre-extracted features, split protocol, early-stopping rule, and metric computation as LEAF-Mamba.
For Mamba-based models, the same fixed coordinate-derived patch serialization is used throughout so that ordering does not confound the comparison.
This protocol isolates the slide-level aggregator stage under frozen features.
blocks.zh:
所有复制的基线都重复使用与LEAF-Mamba相同的预提取特性、分解协议、早期停止规则和计量计算。
对于基于Mamba的模型,整个过程中都使用相同的固定坐标派生补丁序列化,这样订单就不会混淆比较.
此协议在冷冻特性下隔离幻灯片级聚合级.

blocks.en:
LEAF-Mamba uses two evidence-fusion blocks unless otherwise stated.
In the LEA module, the encoder maps the input dimension D D to a latent width d d through a hidden width of 2 ​ d 2d , uses layer normalization, GELU, and dropout 0.25 0.25 , and adds a linear skip projection from the frozen feature.
The decoder mirrors this projection to reconstruct the original frozen feature and contributes the mean-squared reconstruction loss during training.
Each evidence-fusion block applies a local depthwise one-dimensional convolution with kernel size 7 7 , followed by a pointwise convolution, and a global Mamba path with state dimension 32 32 , convolution width 4 4 , and expansion factor 2 2 .
The local and global outputs are concatenated, projected, and modulated by a sigmoid fusion gate before a residual feed-forward update.
After the final block, gated attention pools the refined token features into a slide representation, which is passed to a linear task head.

解码器镜像这种投影来重建原来的冷冻特征,并在训练时造成平均的重建损失.
每个证据聚变区块均采用局部深度的一维演化法,内核大小为7 7 ,然后是点位演化法,以及具有状态维度32 32 , 演化宽度4 4 和扩张因子 2 2 的全曼巴路径.

The BRACS official split provides a representative benchmark-level example: with PLIP features, LEAF-Mamba achieves AUC 77.8, exceeding Jigsaw’s 74.6 by 3.2 percentage points. Together, the average results and this task-specific comparison support the effectiveness of combining feature adaptation with sequence aggregation for diagnostic classification.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,平均AUC分别达到87.7、88.5和89.4,其中ResNet-50、PLIP和CONCH v1.5的特征分别超过了最强基线Jigsaw的1.1、1.9和1.0个百分点。 这种一致的排名显示了所有三个冷冻特性提取器的效益. BRACS官方的拆分提供了一个具有代表性的基准级别的例子:具有PLIP特征的LEAF-Mamba实现了AUC 77.8,超过了Jigsaw的74.6个百分点. 平均结果和这一针对具体任务的比较加在一起,有助于有效地将特征适应与诊断分类的序列汇总结合起来。

blocks.en: Beyond diagnostic classification, Figure 4 shows that LEAF-Mamba also achieves the best average C-Index with each evaluated feature extractor.
blocks.zh: 除诊断分类外,图4显示LEAF-Mamba还用每个被评价的特征提取器实现最佳平均C-Index.

blocks.en: Across the five TCGA cohorts, the average C-Index × 100 \times 100 is 67.0 with ResNet-50 features and 67.3 with PLIP and CONCH v1.5 features. These scores exceed Jigsaw, the strongest survival baseline, by 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3 points, respectively. The leading average performance across all three feature extractors complements the diagnostic results, showing that the combined adaptation and aggregation design is effective for both slide-level classification and survival prediction. This design therefore supports both prediction tasks evaluated here.
blocks.zh: 在五个TCGA组中,平均C-Index × 100\times 100为67.0,具有ResNet-50特性,67.3为PLIP和CONCH v1.5特性。 这些分数分别以0.1分,0.2分和0.3分超过了最强生存基线Jigsaw. 所有三个特征提取器的领先平均性能补充了诊断结果,表明综合适应和聚合设计对滑动级分类和存活率预测都是有效的. 因此,这一设计支持本文评价的两个预测任务。

blocks.en: Table 5 first isolates the aggregation design with LEA enabled. The global-only model achieves 76.8 AUC, 36.4 ACC, and 29.2 F1, exceeding the local-only model on all three metrics. Combining both branches through concatenation, addition, or averaging further improves all three scores over global-only aggregation. Input-dependent gated fusion achieves the highest scores of 78.6 AUC, 40.0 ACC, and 32.7 F1, improving on the global-only model by 1.8, 3.6, and 3.5 percentage points, respectively. Compared with the learned static gate, it gains 0.8 AUC, 2.1 ACC, and 1.4 F1 points. These comparisons support both the use of parallel long-range and sequence-local branches and input-dependent modulation of their joint representation.

blocks.en: Table 6 compares adapters under global-only aggregation. Full LEA achieves 76.8 AUC, 36.4 ACC, and 29.2 F1, compared with 75.1, 34.4, and 27.4 for the frozen PCA bridge. It matches the two-layer MLP in AUC while improving ACC and F1 by 0.3 and 0.9 points. Removing the reconstruction objective reduces AUC, ACC, and F1 to 75.8, 35.8, and 28.1, respectively, demonstrating the contribution of reconstruction regularization in this setting. Full LEA uses 1,250.0K adapter parameters during training and 723.5K during inference; the reconstruction decoder adds training capacity while leaving the inference parameter count equal to that of LEA without reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 表6比较了仅全球汇总下的适配器。 全LEA实现76.8 AUC,36.4 ACC,29.2 F1,而冷冻的PCA桥则达到75.1,34.4和27.4. 它与AUC的两级MLP相匹配,同时将ACC和F1提高0.3和0.9分. 取消重建目标后,哥伦比亚联合自卫军、行政协调会和F1分别减少到75.8、35.8和28.1,表明重建正规化在这一背景下的贡献。 Full LEA在训练时使用1,250.0K适配参数,在推论时使用723.5K;重建解码器增加了训练能力,同时使推论参数的计数等于LEA不重建.

blocks.en: Table 7 examines how adaptation and aggregation work together across four evaluation settings. Relative to global-only aggregation without LEA, the complete model raises AUC from 76.6 to 78.6 on BRACS with CONCH, from 76.9 to 77.8 on BRACS with PLIP, and from 97.2 to 97.9 on Camelyon16. It achieves the highest AUC and ACC in all three classification settings, and the highest F1 in both BRACS settings. On Camelyon16, gated global–local aggregation without LEA has a slightly higher F1 of 92.7 versus 92.5 for the complete model. The effect of adaptation also depends on the aggregator: with PLIP features, adding LEA changes global-only AUC from 76.9 to 75.5, but improves gated global–local AUC from 77.2 to 77.8. For TCGA-BRCA, LEA raises the global-only C-Index from 67.2 to 68.1, while the complete model scores 68.0. Thus, the combined design delivers the strongest classification AUC across the tested settings, while the survival comparison attributes the main improvement to feature adaptation.
blocks.zh: 表7审查了适应和汇总如何在四种评价环境中共同发挥作用。 相对于没有LEA的全局汇总,完整的模型将AUC从CONCH上的BRACS从76.6提高到78.6,将BRACS上的PLIP从76.9提高到77.8,将Camelyon16上的BRACS从97.2提高到97.9。 它在所有三个分类设置中实现了最高的AUC和ACC,在两个BRCS设置中都实现了最高的F1. 在Camelyon16号上,没有LEA的General-local汇总的F1比完整模型的92.5略高。 适应的效果也取决于聚合物:带有PLIP特性,加上LEA改变全局的AUC,从76.9到75.5,但改进了Global-local的AUC,从77.2到77.8. 对于TCGA-BRCA,LEA将全局C-Index从67.2提高到68.1,而完整的型号则得分68.0. 因此,合并设计在经过测试的场合中提供了最强的分类AUC,而生存比较则将主要改进归因于特征适应.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en: 5.1 Interpretation of the Component Analyses
blocks.zh: 5.1 构成部分分析的解释

blocks.en:
The component analyses distinguish the effects of feature adaptation from those of context fusion.
In the BRACS branch comparison, parallel global–local processing improves on either branch alone, and input-dependent fusion further improves on a learned static gate.
In the adapter comparison, removing reconstruction reduces performance, supporting the use of input recovery as an auxiliary training objective.
These results connect the design choices to their controlled variants: adaptation changes the features available to aggregation, while fusion changes how complementary sequence representations are combined.
blocks.zh:
本部分分析将特征适应的效果与上下文融合的效果区分开来.
在BRACS分支比较中,平行的全球-局部处理单靠两个分支都有所改善,而依赖输入的聚变在学习到的静态门上进一步改善.
在适配器比较中,移除重建会降低性能,支持将输入恢复作为辅助培训目标.
这些结果将设计选择与它们所控制的变体联系起来:适应改变可供汇总的特征,而聚变则改变互补序列表示的组合方式.

blocks.en:
The cross-setting results also show that the contributions of the two components depend on the task and the aggregator.
With PLIP features on BRACS, adaptation improves the gated global–local model but does not improve the global-only model’s AUC.
For TCGA-BRCA, the adapted global-only variant slightly exceeds the complete model in C-Index.
Thus, the strongest average benchmark performance of the complete framework does not imply that each component improves every setting.
The evidence supports evaluating adaptation and aggregation jointly, with their individual contributions assessed under matched feature extractors and protocols.
blocks.zh:
交叉设定结果还表明,两个组成部分的贡献取决于任务和汇总器。
在BRCS上具有PLIP的特征,适应改进了有门的Global-local模型,但没有改善Global唯一的模型的AUC.
对于TCGA-BRCA来说,经过改造的全局性变体略高于C-Index中的完整模型.
因此,整个框架最强的平均基准业绩并不意味着每个组成部分都改善了每个设定。
证据支持联合评价适应和汇总情况,以及根据相应的特征提取器和规程评估它们各自的贡献。

blocks.en: 5.2 Scope and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.2 范围和限制

blocks.en: Our study focuses on learning from frozen patch representations, enabling controlled comparisons of adaptation and aggregation across feature extractors. Within this setting, the information available to the model depends on the pretrained encoder; exploring selective encoder fine-tuning would help establish when adaptation at the feature level is sufficient and when updating the encoder offers additional benefits. In addition, local interactions are defined along a fixed coordinate-derived sequence. Comparing alternative spatial orderings and incorporating explicit two-dimensional relationships are promising directions for extending the fusion design. Finally, the current evaluation covers multiple public benchmarks, while transfer across institutions remains an important next step. Independent cohorts with different patient populations and slide preparation practices would help characterize the conditions under which the observed benefits generalize.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究侧重于从冷冻的补丁说明中学习,以便能够对不同特征提取器的适应和汇总进行有控制的比较。 在此情况下,模型可获得的信息取决于预先训练的编码器;探索选择性编码器的微调,将有助于确定特性层面的适应是否足够,以及何时更新编码器是否带来额外好处. 此外,局部相互作用按照固定坐标衍生序列进行定义。 比较其他空间顺序并纳入明确的二维关系,是扩展聚变设计的有希望的方向。 最后,目前的评价涵盖多个公共基准,而跨机构的转让仍然是重要的下一步。 不同病人群的独立群体和幻灯片准备做法将有助于说明所观察到的惠益普遍化的条件。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented LEAF-Mamba, a frozen-feature WSI framework combining reconstruction-regularized token adaptation, long-range sequence modeling, sequence-local convolution, and input-dependent fusion. Our aim was to address a central challenge in weakly supervised computational pathology: adapting pretrained patch representations to downstream tasks while bringing together complementary local and global information. Across feature extractors and prediction tasks, LEAF-Mamba achieves strong overall performance in both diagnostic classification and survival prediction. The component analyses further highlight the value of jointly designing feature adaptation and contextual aggregation. More broadly, these findings suggest that effective use of pathology foundation models depends on how their representations are adapted and integrated into slide-level decisions. This perspective offers a direction for connecting reusable pretrained features with diverse pathology tasks. Future work will extend this approach to cross-institutional evaluation and multimodal learning, exploring how tissue representations can be combined with complementary patient information for more comprehensive disease characterization.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了LEAF-Mamba,一个冷冻的WSI框架,结合了重建-规范化的代号适应,远程序列模型,序列局部演化,以及依赖输入的聚变. 我们的目标是应对一个在缺乏监督的计算病理方面的中心挑战:在汇集互补的地方和全球信息的同时,根据下游任务调整预先训练好的补丁表述。 在整个地物提取器和预测任务中,LEAF-Mamba在诊断分类和生存预测方面都取得了强大的总体性能. 本部分的分析进一步突出了联合设计特征适应和背景汇总的价值。 更广泛地说,这些调查结果表明,对病理基础模型的有效使用取决于这些模型的表达方式是如何调整和融入幻灯片级决策的。 这种视角为将可重复使用的预先训练的特征与不同的病理任务联系起来提供了方向. 今后的工作将把这一办法扩大到跨机构评价和多模式学习,探讨如何将组织表现与补充病人信息结合起来,以便进行更全面的疾病定性。
